title: The warmer binary
what: The bmo-cache-warmer binary: with no subcommand the service itself, and the mcp, health, snapshot and verify commands, with their arguments and environment settings.

title: Service client
what: The client module: one method for each route, sending and reading the wire bodies, with a refusal read back as its status, code and sentence, and no caller's policy.

title: Served routes
what: The warmer's routes over HTTP behind the bearer token: consumers, groups, targets, uses, subjects, the round, passes and the event stream, every refusal in one shape.

title: MCP server
what: The harness plugin's MCP server on standard input and output: the warmer tools, each a thin call of one route through the client, and their schemas from the one table.

title: OpenAPI document
what: The OpenAPI 3.1 document written from the service's types, kept as docs/openapi.json and printed again by the openapi example, with the routes, events, hook and MCP tools.

title: The warming pass
what: The pass itself: judges which targets are due, pings each consumer's hook in order and within its bound, records every attempt, and publishes the target, subject, round and pass events.

title: The warmer's policy
what: The fixed numbers the warmer is built with in policy/warmer.toml: the start delay, tick, bounds, slack, idle share, reason length and event window, read once as the service starts.

title: The round's ticker
what: The beat that runs the first pass after the policy's start delay and then one every interval of the round, never two at once, and takes a new interval while a pass runs.

title: Wire bodies
what: The bodies the routes take and answer, with camelCase keys and epoch-millisecond times, and the shape checks for a name and a kind word that the document, client and tools are written from.
